messages:
maria: FYI product wants to consolidate routing headers: remove legacy `X-Rd-Route`, standardize on `Rd-Route` (versioned). Need SDK owners + console telemetry to sync on migration and quota attribution.
aj: Will this break customers? we need server fallback + client-side deprecation warnings. also small helper for parsing in Go/TS.
sasha: Agreed. Plan: opt-in flag, then a minor release that logs deprecation, then full removal after grace window. I'll draft code snippets for py/ts/go.
chris: Console: add per-tenant tile showing % legacy vs new header and a short migration action panel for CS. Telemetry keys: `route_header_version` and `route_header_source`.
leo: devex-bot: canary run noticed py-sdk header parsing flake when header absent (py#901). I'll track.
aj: I'll add ParseRouteHeader helper in Go/TS that returns (version, source) and emits deprecation metric when legacy seen.
maria: Proposed timeline: announce today, opt-in minor next week, telemetry sampling + console tile w/in 2 weeks, server fallback dry-run at 6 weeks, hard remove at 12 weeks. SDK owners ack + ETAs?
sasha: Ack. py/ts snippets + docs PR today, go PR by Friday.
achris: Ack. console tile ETA 2 weeks, backfill job ETA 3 weeks.
aj: Ack. helper + tests next week.
leo: I'll re-run canaries after PRs. devex-bot: reminder set for 5 days to check PRs and canary status.
